metadata.scenario: A new prospect calls seeking information on the residential cleaning services offered. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, I'm Frank Miller. I wanted to ask about your residential cleaning services. I’m sorry, Frank, but we actually don't offer residential cleaning services. We specialize in home healthcare. Oh, I see. I thought you might have those services. Can you tell me what kind of care you do provide? Absolutely! We offer a variety of services including skilled nursing, personal care assistance, physical therapy, and dementia care. That sounds helpful. I'm currently managing diabetes and wound care. What specific services do you have for that? For diabetes management, we provide blood sugar monitoring and education. Our wound care services include professional assessment and dressing changes. How often do these services need to be scheduled? It typically depends on the client's needs, but many clients have weekly or biweekly visits. I see. And what are the costs associated with those services? Skilled nursing for wound care runs between $95 to $125 per visit, while diabetes management is $70 to $85. That’s understandable. Do you have any availability for a new client? Yes, we can certainly accommodate new clients. I can connect you with our Care Coordinator to discuss specifics. That would be great, thank you! May I have your contact information so I can have Lisa Chen reach out to you? Sure, it’s the same number I called from, +13165552891. Perfect! I’ll make sure she calls you shortly. Is there anything else you’d like to inquire about? No, that’s all for now. Thank you for your help! You're welcome, Frank! We look forward to helping you. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
